3290700.summary: Handles the spirit stone battle action: if the target card is still in play or dying it fires its spirit stone trigger. It then runs the shared end-of-action tail: reorder minions, check for a dead hero and end the match, refresh turn state and UI.
comments: Only trigger the spirit stone if the card is still in play or dying
Action queue is empty: re-seat any minions that ended up out of position
No automatic actions left in the queue: check whether the match has ended
Dead-hero check is skipped in tutorial and campaign matches
Either hero in waitingToDie state (5) means the match is over; isPlayerDead records which one
Builds a debug line for DeadHeroAfterActionsEnd (hero state, UI state, stage); decompiler unrolled the string array
Already in post-battle stage: warn and bail out unless a disconnect loss is pending
Disconnect-loss flag set: record a result with the enemy as winner and run the normal battle end sequence
Normal end: enter post-battle stage, stop the battle, and tell the other client the match finished if networked
Lock the UI into the finish-battle sequence and clear the during-battle flag
Player won: raise a signal with the enemy hero's final health
Get the player's Elo rating (from the leaderboard event if any) and XP to build the ranked match result
Fill in skull milestones, record the result and winner, and the match length in minutes
Player won: flag the win; match types 0x14, 0xd2, 0xb4 also tell LiveOps the opponent was human
Save the winner and finish the battle; returns here instead of reaching the normal tail
Neither hero is dying: let in-play listeners react before finishing
Action finished: clear the resolving-action flag
Enemy's turn: deactivate enemy minions and recompute whether the enemy hero can act or attack
Ferocity/oath heroes may act even while summon-sick: recompute canAct and switch attack type
Show or hide the enemy hero's attack button according to whether it can attack now
Player's turn: light up playable cards and activate the player's minions and hero
Queue empty: run a GC pass while idle and unpause the turn clock
If the player only has end turn available, show the no-actions UI
Scripted (tutorial/campaign) turn: resume scripted actions after the player's manual step
Reset the manual-action marker for the next sequence

3295d78.summary: Removes queued actions caused by a disappearing (jammed/removed) unit from the action, instant, interrupt and delayed-instant queues, optionally keeping destroy actions. Called when a unit leaves play so its pending effects do not fire.
comments: Clean the three main queues with the shared helper
The delayed-instant queue is scanned inline, from the back so removals keep indexes valid
Never cancel action type 1 (seems to be a plain attack)

Caller asked to keep destroy actions (type 0x2d)

Null queue: compiler's null check

3295010.summary: Cancels queued animation actions (type 0xb) belonging to a unit across the action, instant, interrupt and delayed-instant queues. Used when a unit leaves play so its animations do not run on a missing card.

3296378.summary: Removes the action at an index from a queue, first cancelling an attack in progress or hiding the target object depending on the action type. Logs an error if the index is invalid.
comments: Bad queue or index out of range: log an error and do nothing
Action type 1 (attack): cancel the attacker's attack first
Action type 0x17: hide its target object so it does not linger
Finally take the action out of the queue

3291228.summary: Applies a mana buff action to the friendly and/or enemy player: adds or removes Energy slots, refills Energy, or adds spirit stone, faith or quest points, then raises collect signals. Runs the finish callbacks when done.
comments: Closure captures this manager and the battle action for the finish callbacks
Buff applies to the friendly player: process it via ProcessManaBuff
Buff applies to the enemy player too; otherwise done
Pick the target manager: the other side's from the acting player's view
Not spirit stone: check faith, quest points, then plain Energy
Quest points: add them and broadcast one collect event per point
Positive amount: create new Energy slots or refill spent ones
Negative amount: destroy Energy slots or spend Energy
Faith Energy: add it, raise the collect signal and broadcast to the hero
Spirit stone Energy: add it and raise the collect signal
Null manager or missing callback: compiler's null check
